newsitem.title: USA: Hewlett-Packard says cuts printer prices.
newsitem.headline: Hewlett-Packard says cuts printer prices.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co said Monday it is cutting prices on its entire monochrome line of network laserjet printers, a move that it said represents savings of up to 20 percent.
The company said the new prices for these printers range from $1,305 to $8,645. The old price of these printers ranged from $1,629 to $9,549.
The company said the price cuts affect nine types of laser printers including the laserjet 4V, 5 and 5Si printers and the laserjet 5Si. The cuts are effective immediately.
The company said it is the most significant price reduction in the history of its laserjet printers.
The company also said it was cutting the price of some of its toner cartridges 15 percent, and cutting by 15 percent the cost of the output paper-handling accessories for some of its machinese.
